notes: s007 υἱός against the ASV's *an ass* is a textual divergence recorded in the ASV's own note; no variant unit covers this token, so rule 12 forbids a new textual decision and the token is aligned in its slot rather than split into unrepresented plus added.
*shall have … fallen* is one discontinuous realization of πεσεῖται under rule 15, headed on the lexical participle.

ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου → *on a sabbath day* leaves τοῦ unrepresented under rule 23, the ASV writing the genitive attributively with no determiner; the supplied *a* determines the noun phrase and belongs to ἡμέρᾳ under rule 58.
